description: The bar chart illustrates sample counts for four essay genres under two conditions labeled “Open” and “Cons.” The categories are shown on the horizontal axis in the order Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository, while the vertical axis is labeled “Sample Count” and uses a linear scale with tick marks from 0 up to about 130 in increments of 20. For each genre, two adjacent bars are displayed: a light blue bar for “Open” and a light pink bar for “Cons.” with numeric value labels above each bar. Argumentative shows Open at 79 and Cons. at 122; Narrative shows Open at 80 and Cons. at 87; Descriptive shows Open at 68 and Cons. at 100; Expository shows Open at 62 and Cons. at 130. The bars are grouped by genre (side-by-side within each category), a legend at the top identifies the two colors, and there is no additional visual emphasis beyond the value annotations.
